review:
Le Cowboy puts Smokey in a ten-gallon hat on a cluster grid with Super Cascades. Its Revolver Reveal works like this: when a winning cluster includes a wild, that wild becomes a Revolver Cylinder scatter with two to six shots, which fires once all the cascades have settled.

Each shot hits a grid position, and the same position can be hit more than once, triggering reveals on the board. Several cylinders fire in order from top to bottom and left to right. With a 25,000x ceiling, it has the highest cap of the Le games in this batch, and the cluster format sets it apart from the payline titles in the series.
